simple.summary: אֹרְחָה (ʼôrᵉchâh) means a caravan First listed occurrence: Gen 37 25.

definitions.full: H736. orechah [ אֹרְחָה ] noun feminine travelling company, caravan (strictly Participle of אָרַח ), construct אֹרְחַת Gen 37:25 ; plural construct אֹרְחוֺת Isa 21:13 ; compare also below אֹרַח , 4 אֲרִיאֵיל אֲרִיאֵל, etc., see I. & II. ארה .
